_about: The single source of every limit and setting for the autonomous R&D Director and the night visual factory. Changed only by the owner, as a new version; a night never edits it. See docs/autonomous-rd-director.md.

mini._write_protected_files: Literal paths: sshd runs the dispatcher through the user's shell, which reads these files; the dispatcher runs git in work/ outside the sandbox. A sandboxed process must not be able to write them, or rename work/ or the night root.
mini._forbidden_night_processes: The night user runs no Microsoft process: its launchd overrides disable com.microsoft.update.agent, com.microsoft.OneDriveStandaloneUpdater, and com.microsoft.SyncReporter (measured 2026-11-07: they started at its first login; no account, sync folder, or token existed). The dispatcher refuses Unreal steps while one runs as the night user. This lowers the risk; it does not prove separation from the employer's Microsoft 365, which also depends on machine and tenant settings outside this charter.
mini.gui_session: rdnight's own graphical session, logged in by the owner with fast user switching and kept logged in; no automatic login, no launchd

priorities.deadline_first: G2 formally done: run logs scored by the Python Mission Core
propose_only: hold or resume of a theme
priorities.physics_scope: measure drive model P and draft phase G registrations only; no change to P; model K and method D only as proposals
priorities.first_night: one small Visual or Gameplay improvement that shows in a screenshot or a measured number

forbidden: push or merge to any GitHub branch
stopping or signaling a process the night did not start
edits to scoring, gates, registered criteria, phase C records, or raw research data
sign-in, authentication, device registration, or sync with any Microsoft, OneDrive, Microsoft 365, or employer account
copying Roverloom, QUODVIS, Claude Code, or personal research files into OneDrive or any other sync folder
_billing: The Air uses a claude.ai subscription login, not an API key. usd_* caps are compared with Claude Code's list-price estimate (--max-budget-usd, total_cost_usd), not with billing. The wrapper removes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from each cycle's environment. Caps stay null until the owner sets them; a real night refuses to start while they are null.
_approval: Approved by the owner on 2026-11-07 for the first trial night only: 1 cycle, 120 minutes, estimated caps 5 USD per cycle and 12 USD per night (list-price estimates, not billing), memory stop at 25% free, at most 8 Unreal launches; Visual or Gameplay small improvements first; no large change to physics models or evaluation criteria; no GitHub push or merge; no Microsoft or employer account connection or sync; rdnight keeps its own graphical session; no launchd, no automatic login. Approval of the charter and starting a night are separate owner decisions.
